dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Clears this store's trading history — sales, inventory movements and expenses. Products, categories, staff and settings are kept.
dangerZone.resetDescription: This permanently deletes every sale, inventory movement and expense for this store. Products, categories, staff and settings survive. Stock levels stay where they are — adjust them afterwards if needed. This cannot be undone. Type {confirmText} to confirm.
dangerZone.toastReset: {storeName} reset — {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} cleared
